why: The Wuerzburg Cervical Cerclage Simulator is a named, reusable physical training product rather than a general instructional element; its instructional function is simulation-based practice.
name: Wuerzburg Cervical Cerclage Simulator (WCCS)
product_description: A DIY physical obstetric-procedure simulator developed by Buechel and colleagues for training novice and trainee obstetricians in performing McDonald cervical cerclage.

why: This is a named, setting-specific student-grade dataset rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: Anonymized grade dataset of 217 applied-physics students across 27 core courses (2010–2015)
product_description: An anonymized dataset assembled by L. Gajewski et al. from Warsaw University of Technology Faculty of Physics deanery records, containing course grades and student group and specialization records for 217 applied-physics undergraduates across 27 core courses.
